name: Dependency-Aware Architecture Migration Order
migration_principles: Refactor implementation, not the external contract.
Strangler pattern: wrap and delegate before moving core logic.
Zero financial regressions: pin each financial transformation with golden assertion suites before modifying.
Isolate external SDKs behind Infrastructure Adapters first to eliminate remote mock flakiness.
Do not execute migrations in Phase 0.4. This is the sequenced roadmap for Phase 0.5+.

prerequisites: Verified Razorpay HMAC-SHA256 signature verification offline fixtures
steps.risk: LOW (Isolated adapter boundary with 100% deterministic offline tests)
steps.rollback_strategy: Feature flag or IoC binding fallback: re-bind PaymentGatewayInterface directly to legacy App\Services\PaymentService if adapter throws unexpected gateway exceptions.

prerequisites: Unit test coverage for currency conversion fallback (tests/Unit/Services/ExchangeRateServiceTest.php)
steps.risk: LOW (Pure infrastructural adapters with zero domain invariants)
steps.rollback_strategy: Maintain existing service method signatures and delegate to legacy helper methods if environment storage drivers fail.

steps.target_location: App\Domain\Pricing\CampaignPricingEngine (Pure domain service without dynamic circular container lookups)
prerequisites: Decouple dynamic LoyaltyService runtime dependency (pass customer loyalty points as pure value parameter)
steps.risk: MEDIUM (Financial calculation core; pinned by exact penny-level golden fixtures)
steps.rollback_strategy: Legacy CampaignPricingService wraps CampaignPricingEngine. Keep original calculation formulas as fallback if rounding variance exceeds 0.001.

prerequisites: Golden verification comparing output of PricingRuleEngine vs CampaignPricingEngine
steps.risk: MEDIUM (Ensures backward compatibility for dynamic screen pricing multipliers)
steps.rollback_strategy: Direct router delegation to legacy service if adapter mapping fails.

prerequisites: Locking strategy verification (Pessimistic SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or Redis lock)
steps.risk: HIGH (Concurrency sensitive; race conditions could cause double-bookings)
steps.rollback_strategy: Strict atomic transaction rollback. Revert to legacy line-sweep query if slot segment math yields overlapping seconds.

prerequisites: Verify 80/20 provider/platform split and partner commission tiers
steps.risk: HIGH (Monetary payouts to physical media asset owners)
steps.rollback_strategy: Settlement runs in preview/dry-run mode first; verify ledger balance invariance before committing database balance updates.

prerequisites: Steps 1, 3, 5 completed (Payment, Pricing, Availability domains ready)
steps.rollback_strategy: BookingController delegates to CreateCampaignBookingUseCase via try/catch block, falling back to legacy inline method if use case throws UnhandledDomainException.

steps.target_location: Thinned Controllers delegating 100% of business logic to Application Use Cases & Form Requests
steps.risk: MEDIUM (Ensuring HTTP response schemas, status codes, and headers remain identical)
steps.rollback_strategy: Git branch revert of controller file; all underlying domain logic remains intact.
